convert_youtube_vis_to_coco: convert YouTube-VIS dataset annotations to COCO video format for a specified version and mode
run_youtubevis2coco_cli: run the YouTube-VIS to COCO converter CLI with input directory, output directory, and dataset version
convert_vis_train: convert YouTube-VIS train dataset to COCO VIS format with annotations and instance tracking
convert_vis_valid: convert YouTube-VIS validation dataset to COCO VIS format with annotations and instance tracking
convert_vis_test: convert YouTube-VIS test dataset to COCO VIS format without annotations
